natural_body: 40% discounts raise acquisition and revenue but hurt retention and renewals.

first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ, the most acute problem. Memory_91 shows activation messaging drives week-one engagement; memory_86 shows onboarding improvements lift adoption. Verifying both validates that in-product engagement messaging can address the activation drop without the retention risk of promotional_pricing (memory_73) or the enterprise-only upside of sales_assist. Referral incentives (memory_57) are effective but require established customers—we need to fix the funnel first. A standard experiment on activation messaging targets the immediate problem while preserving our ability to layer onboarding simplification or referral strategies later.
